desc:
Start with one little bunny meadow and grow it into the biggest zoo in town!

Pull carrots, grab hay and catch fish to feed your animals, and visitors pay you for every bite. Open new exhibits with goats, penguins, monkeys, pandas, elephants and horses you can ride. Restock your gift shop, put on animal shows, and hire zookeepers to run the zoo for you!

Expand your zoo, collect every animal in the Index, and visit and like your friends' zoos!

Please Like the game! It helps me out a lot!
